project_type: Python FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Workers edge + Vite React frontend monorepo
build_system: pnpm workspaces for JS, pip for Python backend, Docker for backend container
build_command: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit && cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.in
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend linting: ruff check apps/backend/app/  2. Run backend tests: pytest apps/backend/ --tb=short -q  3. Run edge TypeScript check: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit  4. Verify no azure imports remain in backend app code (grep check)
setup_instructions: 1. pip install the backend dependencies from requirements.in  2. pnpm install for edge/frontend  3. Set APP_ENV=test and JWT_SECRET for testing
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Python 3.11 and Node 22 available. No Docker daemon available for docker build.
contribution_requirements: Uses pnpm 10.26.1, Node >= 22, Python 3.11. CI uses ruff for linting, pytest for tests, tsc --noEmit for edge.
key_patterns: Singleton service pattern (search_service, vertex_client, sarvam_client), pydantic-settings for config, circuit breaker pattern for external services, async-first with httpx, Cloudflare Worker proxies all /api/ requests to backend URL via AZURE_BACKEND_URL env var
directory_structure: apps/backend/ - FastAPI Python backend with app/ (api, services, models, core, db), apps/edge/ - Cloudflare Worker TS proxy, apps/frontend/ - Vite React SPA, infra/ - azure/ Bicep templates + scripts/, .github/workflows/ - CI/CD
